title_zh: 约定修改健康活动传单并交讲者核对

scenario.label_zh: 商定健康活动传单修订及复核安排
scenario.goal_zh: 商定修改传单的责备性措辞并补正讲者称谓和免费信息，约定由讲者复核健康内容后再印刷

context_zh: 社区健康活动编辑萨拉与志愿者托比核对一份虚构活动宣传传单，不提供个人健康建议。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.text: The leaflet says, 'Bad choices cause obesity.' I don't think we should print that.

sentences.speaker: Toby
sentences.text: Agreed. It blames people and turns a complex topic into a slogan.

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.text: Could the title be 'Nutrition questions: an open conversation' instead?

sentences.speaker: Toby
sentences.text: Yes. We can say the event welcomes adults living with obesity, without making promises about results.

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.text: The speaker's title should be 'registered dietitian', not 'doctor'. And the session is free; that needs to be visible.

sentences.speaker: Toby
sentences.text: I'll correct those details and remove the sentence about bad choices.

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.text: Then please send the health information to the speaker for review before anything goes to print.

sentences.speaker: Toby
sentences.text: I will. I'll mark this as a draft until we've had that review.

targets.sense_zh: 营养；饮食与营养的关系
